snmp_configgen.v2c_template:
config system snmp sysinfo
    set status enable
end
config system snmp community
    edit 1
        set name "<<community>>"
        set status enable
        set query-v2c-status enable
        config hosts
            edit 1
                set ip <<mgmt_subnet>> <<mask>>
            next
        end
    next
end
snmp_configgen.v3_template:
config system snmp user
    edit "<<sec_name>>"
        set status enable
        set queries enable
        set query-port 161
        set security-level auth-priv
        set auth-proto sha
        set auth-pwd <<auth_key>>
        set priv-proto aes
        set priv-pwd <<priv_key>>
    next
end
